decision: The competitor (McLaren Formula 1 Team) is fined €5,000.
fact: Team personnel and equipment in Pit Lane during the Race.
offence: Breach of Article 34.13 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the team representative and reviewed video evidence. While it is not unusual for team personnel to move towards the Parc Fermé area before the end of the race, McLaren had team members and equipment in the pit lane while other teams were still pitting and thus created a potentially unsafe condition.
rules_referenced: Article 34.13 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
evidence presented. ### Tim Mayer Matteo Perini ### Johnny Herbert Danil Solomin
